_what: Recording the screen as a helper process (tools/record-the-screen/do-work/capture-session.mjs). A recording is one chosen display or one chosen window (`source_kinds`); the capturer that records it is the first row of `capturers`, in order, that this Mac has, that can take that kind of source and that can leave out what the person listed. A capturer is a program: its JSON config goes in as `{config}` on its command line, and the verbs pause, resume and stop reach it as the row says (`stdin` text, or a `signal`; a verb the row does not give is refused in words, never faked). `handshake` is the line it prints when it is really recording (null: it records as soon as it runs). The recording is written into a fresh private folder under `work_dir` and only `save` moves it to a place the person chose, which must be under `save.allowed_roots`, not under `save.refused_roots`, with an allowed extension. The person's own choices are the file `prefs_file` (hide_own_windows, pointer, fps, exclude: { apps, titles }, overrides: { <app name>: { capturer, fps } }); `defaults` is what holds until they choose. Pointer: only positions and button presses are noted, never keys, normalised to the captured source and written as the `pointer` sidecar. `capture_shield` names the two Darwin notifications posted around a recording so the app's own windows are left out of it (do-work/capture-shield.mjs).

words.source_required: Say what to record: a display or a window ({kinds}). Nothing is recorded without one.
words.source_unknown: There is no {kind} called {id} to record right now.
words.no_capturer: No program on this Mac can record that: {why}
words.why_none_have: none of the capturers is installed here
words.why_leaves_out: {id} cannot leave out the apps and windows you listed ({list})
words.busy: A recording is already running ({id}). Stop it first.
words.source_gone: The {kind} being recorded went away, so the recording ended.
words.nothing_to_save: There is nothing recorded to save.
words.save_outside: {place} is not under a place recordings may be saved. They may go under: {roots}.
words.save_refused: {place} is a place recordings are never saved.
words.save_extension: A recording is saved as one of {extensions}.
words.save_link: {place} is a link; recordings are not written through links.
words.pref_unknown: There is no setting {name}. They are: {names}.
words.exclude_what: Say whether to leave out an app or a window title.
words.pointer_none: No pointer was noted for this recording.
